description: You are helping Sarah Chen prepare a comprehensive medication history document for her new doctor. Her previous practice closed suddenly, and she needs to reconstruct her medication history from fragmented sources. Open the document at /home/ga/Documents/TextDocuments/medication_history_sarah_chen.docx and review the four source files in the same directory (pharmacy_partial_records.txt, old_pill_bottles_notes.txt, calendar_insurance_notes.txt, patient_memory_notes.txt). Create a well-organized medication history document with sections for: (1) Patient Information, (2) Current Medications (at least 2), (3) Past Medications (at least 4 with dates and discontinuation reasons), (4) Allergies/Adverse Reactions. Format with clear section headings and save the document (Ctrl+S).
